sorting_detail: FACS-purified Lin-CD34+ AML cells. Two-step gate: (1) lineage depletion using biotinylated CD2 CD3 CD14 CD16 CD19 CD56 and CD235a followed by streptavidin-FITC with negative gating; (2) CD34-APC positive selection. Viability gate by Annexin-V-Pacific-blue exclusion. CD38 was stained but NOT used to restrict the sort so both CD38-negative LSC and CD38-positive progenitor fractions are present. Sorted on a BD FACSAria III; post-sort purity 95.3 +/- 1.3 percent by reanalysis.
open_questions: aml_ontogeny unknown - the trial text says de novo secondary and therapy-related AML were all eligible but Supplementary Table 3 has no ontogeny column so the per-patient assignment cannot be recovered; mutation_assay unknown - source says next-generation sequencing without naming the panel and the breadth matters for reading a short mutation list; fusion unknown - banding found no acquired translocation but no dedicated fusion assay is described; sample_state unknown - fresh versus cryopreserved is never stated for the trial samples; library_batch unknown - no batch label declared anywhere; sorting vocabulary cannot carry the CD34 positive-selection layer and the lineage depletion here also removes Mono_DC and NK which the red-flag definition does not list; best BM flow-MRD positive versus best PB flow-MRD negative while the sequenced material is PB - the schema has no MRD compartment field so the BM reading was used; remission status at C1D1 is unresolvable from public records; this row lands in Appendix A `Excluded` because MRD_residual requires a remission_status value
curator_note: n_libraries_merged=1: this GSM has two SRA runs that share one SRX and one BioSample so they are sequencing lanes of a single 10x library; per R1 they merge into one row and both SRR are written into run_ids. tissue=PB: neither the main text nor the Methods states the compartment for the scRNA-seq samples; GEO source_name is 'blood' and the submitter sample name ends in BL which corroborates. Every bone-marrow assay in the paper is a separate experiment. bm_collection is therefore not_applicable. barcode_preserved=TRUE: AvgSpotLen=117 equals 26 bp Read 1 plus 91 bp Read 2 so the SRA fastq retains the 10x cell barcode; DATASTORE filetype lists only sra/fastq/run.zq with no TenX entry so no CellRanger BAM is deposited and bamtofastq is not needed. sorting: the real gate is two steps (seven-marker lineage depletion then CD34 positive selection). V7 has no combined value; blast_enriched_lin_depleted was chosen because it is the red-flag value that forces T_NK B_Plasma and Erythroid to be masked as NA rather than zero-filled downstream. The depletion here is BROADER than the red-flag definition: CD14 CD16 and CD56 are also removed so Mono_DC and NK are technically absent too. The CD34 positive-selection layer is not carried by the vocabulary value and lives only in sorting_detail. This row is L1-only. mutation_assay=unknown: Methods say mutations were determined by 'next-generation sequencing' without stating panel WES or WGS. fusion=unknown not none: chromosome banding with a minimum of 20 metaphases was performed and reported no acquired translocation but no dedicated fusion assay is described so 'none' would overstate the evidence. eln_risk was assigned post hoc per footnote # of Supplementary Table 3; eln_edition=2017 is stated in that table header. blast_pct_clinical uses the Supplementary Table 3 BM cytomorphology column for cross-dataset comparability with the project morphologic-blast anchor even though the sequenced material is PB. The ONLY cytogenetic finding for this patient is a CONSTITUTIONAL der(13;14) Robertsonian translocation so the leukemia is effectively normal-karyotype; combined with DNMT3A as the sole reported mutation this donor is expected to produce an empty inferCNV result which must map to NA and not to malignant=0. PB blast percentage not reported at this timepoint. mrd_status=positive is a Rule B LOGICAL IMPLICATION and not a date inference: Supplementary Table 8 records this patient's BEST bone-marrow flow-MRD as positive at >=10^-3 so no earlier timepoint can be better; curation_status is therefore NOT downgraded. Note the same table records this patient's best PB flow-MRD as NEGATIVE while the sequenced material is PB; the BM reading was taken because BM flow-MRD is the ELN standard assessment and the schema has no MRD compartment field. remission_status stays unknown because best hematologic response CR is a whole-course best and only 3 of 12 patients were responders at C1D1 with the cohort BM blast average still 32 percent; the paper does not say whether this patient was one of them. Sample drawn 14 days after a single dose of cusatuzumab monotherapy and before any azacitidine. GEO Sample_title verbatim = 'C8, C1D1'. Author-reported malignant fraction = 74 percent at this timepoint.

sorting_detail: FACS-purified Lin-CD34+ AML cells. curator_note: NO PUBLICATION EXISTS. GEO records 'Citation missing' and no paper could be found; the submitter of record is a contract research organisation (Shanghai OE Biotech) and the listed contact is the CRO not a clinical investigator. GEO plus SRA are therefore the ONLY sources and most of Block 2 and Block 3 are permanently empty - age sex karyotype driver mutations ELN risk blast percentage mutation assay and days from diagnosis do not exist in any public record. The characteristics field reads literally 'genotype: NA'. IDENTITY IS DECODED FROM THE LIBRARY NAME AND NOT FROM THE GEO TITLE (D1). The library name has the form AML{NN}{FAB}_{TIMEPOINT} and appears identically in the supplementary filenames and in the bracketed token of the title. The free-text part of the title is demonstrably broken: all seven samples read 'from Patient 1' even though the library names carry AML01 AML02 and AML03 and even though AML01 is M4 while AML02 and AML03 are M5; the three _P samples are captioned 'primary remission' or '(primary) remission'; and the _CR sample is captioned 'partial remission' although its suffix is CR. Reading the title literally would collapse seven samples from three donors onto one donor which is exactly the GSE185381 phantom-edge failure mode. THE DECODING IS CORROBORATED BY TWO INDEPENDENT STRUCTURED SOURCES. (1) The characteristics field 'treatment' reads 'before HSCs transplantation' for all three _P samples and 'post HSCs transplantation' for _CR and all three _RE samples; the same column is present independently in the SraRunTable. (2) The series summary names exactly three stages - newly diagnosed complete remission and relapse - and AML01 has exactly three samples P CR RE which is the only assignment that uses all three named stages. AvgSpotLen is 287 to 289 which falls OUTSIDE every band of the schema read-structure probe (26/28 = R1 only; 90-150 = R2 only ie barcode stripped; 116-178 = R1 plus R2). It is most consistent with a 150 plus 150 paired-end run in which case the barcode is fully retained with extra cDNA in R1 - but that cannot be asserted without reading a spot so barcode_preserved stays unknown pending the check. cell_prep sorting and matrix_level are all unknown for the same reason: the extract protocol starts downstream of any isolation step. The token BMMCs appears in all seven titles and would imply mononuclear_unspecified but the title field has demonstrated errors so it is not used as sole evidence (D4). treatment_line_number is unknown for the post-transplant rows: reaching allogeneic HSCT normally implies prior antileukemic therapy but the source never states any induction so the number of lines cannot be filled. Patient AML01 timepoint CR = complete remission after allogeneic HSCT; characteristics treatment = post HSCs transplantation. remission_status=CR is taken from the library-name suffix and is corroborated by the series summary which names 'complete remission' as one of the three stages; the GEO title says 'partial remission' and is discarded under D1. Under Appendix A this row maps to MRD_residual (Post_transplant plus CR) even though no MRD assay is reported anywhere - mrd_status stays not_assessed.

sorting_detail: Three immunomagnetic (MACS) fractions were prepared from the same enzymatic digest and then POOLED INTO A SINGLE 10x reaction per donor. (1) RBC-depleted, unenriched (STEMCELL 18170) - a 20 uL aliquot was set aside; (2) CD45-depleted (EasySep Human CD45 Depletion Kit II, STEMCELL 17898) from 67 percent of the remaining cells, to recover non-hematopoietic cells in an unbiased fashion; (3) CD34-enriched (EasySep Human CD34 Positive Selection Kit II, STEMCELL 17856) from 33 percent. Each fraction was resuspended at 1000 cells per uL and the three were pooled IN A RATIO FAVORING REPRESENTATION OF RARE HSPCs AND NON-HEMATOPOIETIC CELLS, then loaded on 10x Chip G. No FACS was used for the sequenced material; FACS appears in this paper only for the separate CFU-F sorting experiments.

curator_note: CELL-TYPE PROPORTIONS IN THIS DATASET ARE A PIPETTING DECISION AND NOT BIOLOGY. Three MACS fractions were pooled into one 10x reaction per donor in a ratio deliberately chosen to over-represent rare HSPCs and non-hematopoietic cells, so stroma HSPC and plasma cells are all enriched far above their marrow frequency (non-hematopoietic cells are <0.5 percent of true marrow cellularity per the paper's own introduction). Any downstream metric that reads node proportions is invalid on these rows without correction; the authors themselves ran CellChat with population.size=TRUE which is the wrong setting for an artificially composed pool. cell_prep=whole_marrow_RBClysis is a VOCABULARY APPROXIMATION chosen under D3 to carry the one thing V9 exists to carry - that this is NOT a mononuclear preparation. The paper states explicitly that the full granulocyte differentiation trajectory was captured 'by virtue of our sample processing not including density-based isolation of mononuclear cells', and that numerous plasma cells were captured as a byproduct of CD45 depletion. Two facts the value does not carry: red cells were removed by IMMUNOMAGNETIC DEPLETION not lysis, and the starting material was enzymatically digested trabecular bone not aspirated marrow - those are carried by dissociation and bm_collection respectively. bm_collection=biopsy_bone_fragment: femoral heads removed at total hip arthroplasty were cut coronally into 4-6 mm slices then minced to ~1 mm cubes and digested in 4 mg/mL dispase II plus 2 mg/mL collagenase I for 1 h at 37 C. This is the ONLY dataset in the project that is not an aspirate, which is precisely why it contains real MSC endothelial and osteolineage cells. disease=non_heme_condition and control_type=non_leukemic_control (D2): these donors are NOT healthy volunteers - every one had osteoarthritis or degenerative joint disease and the femoral head was surgical waste deemed IRB-exempt. The authors' own justification for calling them hematologically healthy is that osteoarthritis is a peri-articular disease not associated with haematologic complications. timepoint_class=Healthy still holds per V4 item 1 (non-leukaemic donor) so the Appendix A Healthy axis is unaffected. n_libraries_merged=1: this GSM has two SRA runs sharing one SRX and one BioSample so they are sequencing lanes of a single 10x library; both SRR are written to run_ids. barcode_preserved=TRUE: AvgSpotLen=138 equals 28 bp Read 1 (16 CB + 12 UMI, v3.1) plus 110 bp Read 2, inside the schema probe band for R1+R2 present. CellRanger v6.1.2 was run against GRCh38 WITH INTRONIC REGIONS INCLUDED, which raises counts for nuclei-rich and low-RNA populations relative to every other dataset in this project - a real cross-dataset confounder for any UMI-threshold QC. Genetic Block 3 is not_applicable throughout: these are non-leukaemic donors and no cytogenetic or mutational assay was performed. Surgical indication verbatim: 'Left hip primary osteoarthritis.'. Ethnicity as recorded in Table S1: N/A. Collection dates for the sequenced cohort span 2022-01-26 to 2022-09-21. NAMING ANOMALY: the GEO title for this sample is 'H14_MACS_scRNA-seq' whereas the other eleven read 'H{NN}_scRNA-seq'. No source states that H14 was processed differently - Table S1 lists its assay as CODEX/scRNA-Seq exactly like six other donors, and the Methods describe a single protocol applied to all digests. Two circumstantial signals nevertheless warrant a check: this is the EARLIEST scRNA-seq collection (2022-01-26, ten weeks before the next one on 2022-04-06) which is consistent with a protocol-development sample, and every fraction in the protocol is MACS-based so the suffix is uninformative as a label. Per R3 the suffix is NOT used to derive any field; the row is filled identically to the other eleven and the question is pushed to a composition check.
